rubric: A spelling mistake in a comment.

criteria.severity: style, naming or a suggestion the author may ignore

reading.why: A misspelt word in a comment is a suggestion the author may ignore, whatever the reviewer's label.

ruledOut.question: severity
ruledOut.label: blocker
ruledOut.why: It is a suggestion in a comment. It is not: a bug or a security hole a reviewer would block the merge on.

ruledOut.question: severity
ruledOut.label: should_fix
ruledOut.why: It is a suggestion in a comment. It is not: wrong or fragile, but mergeable with a follow-up.
